model_name: N15 Secondary Pusher 0-D v0.2 clean separation
notes: The D-T starter, p+N15 secondary, and CNO target are separate energy buckets.
The external-pusher fraction x is burned outside the CNO target; its C12 product is recovered and later loaded into oven 1.
The remaining 1-x N15 is optionally mixed into oven 1 only for a comparison; x=1 is the clean architecture.
Target geometry and density remain frozen at the archived three-oven values; only seed temperature is scanned.
The allocation sweep starts at prescribed maximum compression and does not penalize mixed N15 for premature ignition during the inward implosion.
Each reaction Q is deposited at most once.
